compact: Summarizes the conversation so far to free up space so it can keep going.
model: Switches which Claude model this session uses.
clear: Starts a fresh conversation and wipes the current one.
init: Creates a CLAUDE.md file that tells Claude about this project.
simplify: Reviews the code you just changed for repeats and clutter, then cleans it up.
code-review: Reviews the current changes and reports real bugs.
security-review: Reviews the pending changes for security problems.
loop: Runs a prompt again and again on a timer.
schedule: Creates or manages cloud agents that run on a schedule.
claude-api: Reference for building apps with the Claude API and the Anthropic SDK.
update-config: Changes Claude Code settings such as permissions, hooks and environment variables.
fewer-permission-prompts: Adds allow rules so Claude asks you for permission less often.
run: Starts the project's app so you can see a change working.
workflow-authoring: Reference for writing a multi-agent workflow script.
dataviz: Guidance for making clear, consistent charts and dashboards.
mcp: Shows and manages connections to outside tools (MCP servers).
permissions: Shows and changes what Claude is allowed to do without asking.
help: Shows help and the list of commands.
cost: Shows what this session has cost so far.
